newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile February industrial output falls, sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Chile February industrial output falls, sales rise.

text.p: Chile's industrial production fell 1.3 percent in February against the same month last year, while sales rose 1.5 percent over the same period, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figures showed industrial output rose 0.5 percent in the first two months of the year with sales up 5.2 percent.
Production fell in February in industries including food manufacturing, down 8.8 percent, construction machinery, down 24 percent, and oil derivatives, which dropped 11.4 percent.
The figures exclude copper smelting and refining.
